messages:
maria (AE): Hey team — ACME's POC is blocked, they can't correlate requests in our Console. Their app shows 429s and the trace IDs aren't appearing. Can @sam or @dave jump in? They need this for a demo tomorrow morning.

acme-poc-contact: we're seeing a bunch of failed requests — headers from our side include X-Request-Id but the Console shows no traces. Example error from client: `HTTP 429 {\"error\":\"rate_limit\"}`. We also get intermittent 500s.

sam (Sales SE): pinging eng-sre. maria — can you paste a raw request + headers and the SDK/agent version? Also, are they using hosted or private?

maria (AE): hosted. curl example they shared:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'X-Request-Id: 6f9a2b' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-like","input":"hi"}'
```
They said Console Trace column is empty and the logs in Console live-tailer show no trace_id key.

dave (eng-sre): thanks. two quick checks: 1) our trace propagation header defaults to `x-trace-id` / `traceparent` — if the app is sending `X-Request-Id` we won't pick it up automatically. 2) 429s at 150rpm sounds like token-based rate limits — need request ids to map to gateway logs.

dave (eng-sre): can we get a sample gateway log line? ideally something like:
```
2026-03-21T14:12:03Z gateway request_id=6f9a2b status=429 path=/v1/generate client_ip=1.2.3.4
```

acme-poc-contact: here is a snippet from our side + gateway log (redacted):
```
client> POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer REDACTED
X-Request-Id: 6f9a2b
User-Agent: acme-service/1.2.3

server> 2026-03-21T14:12:03Z gateway request_id=6f9a2b status=429 token_bucket=acme-team
```

sam (Sales SE): OK. Two levels: immediate workaround — have them duplicate X-Request-Id into x-trace-id so Console links. Permanent — we can add header mapping on our ingress for their tenant. @lee can we apply a tenant-specific mapping?

lee (devex): yes, we can add a header mapping rule on the hosted ingress to map `X-Request-Id -> x-trace-id` for that tenant. I need the tenant id and a short maintenance window. Also add that they should upgrade SDK to 0.9.4 — older clients don't emit traceparent by default.

acme-poc-contact: tenant id is acct-9281. Maintenance window anytime tonight after 22:00 PT. We can also change client to send `x-trace-id` if that's faster.

deploy-bot: incident-note: rate-limit-threshold-triggered for token bucket `acme-team` at 2026-03-21T14:12:00Z — throttling applied.

dave (eng-sre): For the 500s — can you capture the full response body of one 500? Sometimes it's a transient model backend OOM; logs will show `model=foo instance=3 oom=true` if so. If it's a gateway 500 we'll see backend_id in the gateway logs.

acme-poc-contact: attached one: `HTTP 500 {\"error\":\"backend_oom\",\"backend_id\":\"m-3\"}`

sam (Sales SE): sounds like two orthogonal issues: model instance OOMs causing 500s, and header mismatch causing Console to not link logs/traces. Action items: 1) @dave run tenant header mapping tonight, 2) @acme-poc-contact throttle client to 100rpm while we stabilize, 3) @lee enable live-tail filter on Console for acct-9281 so SE can watch.

lee (devex): will do. Console steps for live-tail filter: Settings -> Observability -> Live tail -> add filter `tenant:acct-9281` and `level:warn,error`. I'll also add a dashboard widget for request rate vs 429s.

maria (AE): customer agreed to throttle. Can we also export logs to their Splunk? They asked about forwarding.

dave (eng-sre): we support log drains to HTTP/S, and a Splunk HEC integration — need the HEC token+endpoint. Note export will include request metadata only if trace header present.

acme-poc-contact: we'll send HEC creds in the secure doc. One more ask: can Console show the original X-Request-Id in metadata so our engineers don't need to change anything?

dave (eng-sre): short term I'll add mapping and also copy `X-Request-Id` into `x-original-request-id` in our logs so Console shows it. Longer term recommend standardizing on W3C `traceparent`.

maria (AE): awesome — thanks everyone. I'll confirm tomorrow after the window. :thumbsup:

lee (devex): mapping applied at 22:05 PT and live-tail filter pre-configured. I'll spin up a dashboard widget and share link in this thread once it's stable.

maria (AE): update from acme: after header mapping their traces appear in Console and they can correlate to X-Request-Id. 429s dropped after lowering client to 100rpm and we queued a model-rolling change to increase capacity. Closing for now, will re-open if issues recur.

acme-poc-contact: confirmation from our side — demo tomorrow looks good. thanks folks! :party_parrot:
